temporal_validity.note: skipped where no health-label onsets exist

explanation_faithfulness.note: score must DROP when the flagged subsequence is masked; reduction > 0 is the pass signal (PRD §24)

temporal_proxies.note: proxy, NOT ground-truth onset alignment: MIMII anomalous clips are anomalous from t=0, so the first over-threshold window is a pseudo-onset. Threshold = 99th pct of normal eval windows (PRD §11 thresholding convention).

notes: All six PRD §24 metrics; fitting on train/val units only; labels consumed for evaluation only (PRD §23).
